title: Forces & Motion  -  Group Work (clusters)
collective_reasoning: The group is likely to argue that heavier objects fall faster because they feel stronger or more forceful.

noah_g5_fractions.target_label: Ask about Noah's prediction, then push
noah_g5_fractions.opening_line: The heavier ball will hit the ground first, because it's heavier.
noah_g5_fractions.win_line: Oh... when we dropped them they landed together. So weight isn't what makes it fall faster.

marcus_volatile.target_label: Calm him first, then back to the ramp
marcus_volatile.opening_line: (shoves the materials) Our cart won't roll right, this is dumb!
marcus_volatile.win_line: ...fine. Maybe the ramp's too flat. I'll put it up a little.

deshawn_offtask.opening_line: (spinning the wheel, off task) Watch how fast I can make it go!
deshawn_offtask.win_line: Aight, aight. I'll write down how far it goes each push.

diego_ell.target_label: Wait, then revoice his force idea
diego_ell.opening_line: I push... it moves. But 'force', I am not sure the word.
diego_ell.win_line: So a push or a pull, that's a force. Bigger push, it goes farther.

meilin_anxious.target_label: Praise her method, not how smart she is
meilin_anxious.opening_line: Our group's measurement is probably wrong. I'm bad at science.
meilin_anxious.win_line: Okay... so measuring three times and taking the average is a good way. I can do that.

talia_dominator.opening_line: I'll do all the pushing AND the recording AND the talking!
talia_dominator.win_line: Fine, I'll push. Sam can write it down. Everybody gets a job.

priya_quiet.opening_line: (quietly has the cleanest data table, rarely asked)
priya_quiet.win_line: Um, ours went farther every time we pushed harder. I wrote the numbers down.

sam_withdrawn.win_line: Maybe... a smoother ramp lets it roll farther?

story_hook: Ramps, carts, and a room full of kids who are sure heavy things go faster. Can their own data change that?
